items.title: Critical WordPress flaw CVE-2026-87902 exploited within hours of disclosure
items.summary: A critical unauthenticated path-traversal flaw (CVSS 9.2) in WordPress versions 4.7.0–7.1.1 lets attackers trick the template loader into including arbitrary PHP files, enabling remote code execution on some configurations. WordPress patched it in 7.1.2 on Sep 22 and backported the fix; Patchstack saw exploitation attempts within hours, including abuse of pearcmd.php.

items.title: ShinyHunters resumes mass exploitation of Oracle PeopleSoft flaw after bypassing WAF rules
items.summary: Google Threat Intelligence/Mandiant said the ShinyHunters group is mass-exploiting CVE-2026-35273 in Oracle PeopleSoft, URL-encoding a single path character to evade string-based WAF rules while hitting unpatched servers. Dozens of systems across education, healthcare, tech and government are affected; Oracle's June 10 out-of-band patch remains the required fix.

items.title: Chrome 154 patches 108 security flaws, 11 rated Critical
items.summary: Google's Chrome 154.0.8037.57 stable release fixes 108 security issues, including 11 Critical flaws such as ANGLE buffer overflows, a GPU out-of-bounds write and ServiceWorker/Fullscreen use-after-free bugs. Google is withholding some details until more users update; none are currently listed as exploited in the wild.

items.title: Kiteworks urges customers to shut down servers amid 'imminent' cyberattack threat
items.summary: Kiteworks, the secure file-transfer vendor formerly Accellion, told customers to take servers offline for a six-hour weekend window after receiving credible law-enforcement threat intelligence of a potentially imminent attack. The company says it is not aware of any compromise and points customers to release 9.5.1, which contains fixes for all known vulnerabilities.

items.title: Orval mass disclosure: three CVSS 9.8 code-injection flaws in generated clients
items.summary: Researchers disclosed three critical code-injection vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-96754, CVE-2026-96755, CVE-2026-96759) in Orval, a tool that generates TypeScript clients from OpenAPI specs. Attacker-controlled spec values are embedded unescaped into generated code, so a malicious spec can execute during build or import. Orval 8.29.0 patches all three; users are told to audit specs from untrusted sources.

items.title: Stevens Point city network breached; no evidence of resident data compromise yet
items.summary: Officials in Stevens Point, Wisconsin said unauthorized access to the city's computer network detected Sep 23 was cut off, with forensic teams and state and federal agencies investigating. The city reports no evidence that citizen or employee data was compromised, though phone and email services remain intermittently disrupted.
